These are separate day and night scenes so the sun and moon are not impossibly in one sky. Each target object must be unmistakable and unobscured. images.title: 江南看图说方位
images.altText: 江南池塘：花在莲叶上方，鱼在莲叶下方的水里，小船在莲叶旁边。
images.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: primary grade-one Chinese 江南 position-word picture exercise. Wide 3:2 children's watercolor illustration of a Jiangnan pond. Clear blue water, broad green lotus leaves, a few pink lotus blossoms. One small wooden boat with one child sitting in it is beside a large lotus leaf. Clearly visible orange fish swim below the water surface and below lotus leaves. A blossom stands above a leaf. The scene supports saying above, below, beside: flower above leaf, fish below leaf, boat beside lotus leaves. Gently show below-water fish in a shallow transparent water foreground without impossible floating fish. No extra boats, no numbers, no labels, no Chinese or English text, no watermark. Child-friendly uncluttered soft watercolor, objects easy to point to. Not a publisher image reproduction.
constraints: 上方、下方、旁边的关系明确

images.title: 老鼠嫁女故事图
images.altText: 六幅故事图依次为老鼠寻找太阳、云遮太阳、风吹云、墙挡风、老鼠在墙洞边、老鼠婚礼。
images.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: companion picture sequence for the grade-one oral storytelling activity 老鼠嫁女. A single landscape 3:2 sheet with six equal separated panels in a 3 columns by 2 rows layout, left-to-right story sequence. Traditional Chinese children's watercolor folklore illustration, warm ivory paper, parent mice in simple clothes and a young bride mouse in a red folk wedding dress consistently recognizable throughout. Panel 1 parent mice looking up at a bright sun, seeking a strong bridegroom. Panel 2 a large cloud covers that sun while parent mice look up. Panel 3 swirling wind pushes a cloud aside; parent mice standing safely on ground. Panel 4 wind ribbons stop at a strong brick wall. Panel 5 a small male mouse emerges from a neat hole in the brick wall and parent mice see him. Panel 6 happy mouse wedding celebration, the same bride mouse and male mouse bridegroom standing together with parent mice. No cat, no violence, no text, no speech bubbles, no labels or numbers, no watermark. Six panels clearly separated by white gutters, no cropped characters, no publisher art imitation.
constraints: 六幅图按阅读顺序排列

images.title: 刘胡兰看图讲述
images.altText: 冬天的旧村庄庙院前，十五岁的刘胡兰神态坚定，乡亲们在后方。
images.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: companion illustration for Chinese grade-two reading 刘胡兰 and the related look-at-picture retelling activity. A respectful calm children's watercolor historical illustration of a rural Chinese winter village in 1947. A brave fifteen-year-old Chinese girl Liu Hulan stands upright in front of a modest old village temple courtyard. She has youthful face, simple braided dark hair, gray cotton-padded jacket and plain dark-blue trousers, no makeup or modern details. A small group of adult villagers in modest old cotton winter clothing stand in the background, a bare tree and cold winter sky. The teenage girl is foreground focus, composed determined expression, a breeze moving her jacket hem. Gentle muted blue-gray and warm earthy colors, landscape 3:2, restrained dignified mood suitable for young readers. Do not depict violence, execution tools, weapons, blood, death, wounds, slogans, flags, uniforms with insignia, lettering or watermark. This illustrates her courage and the village setting without inventing a violent event.
